[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
Joseph was born in 1820. He was the son of [[Glasgow-193|James Glasgow]] and [[McNeil-3468|Mary McNeil]]. He passed away in 1866.
== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-193]] is assessed at 89% (probable). Faris’s 1990 Glasgow Family genealogy p.80 supports Joseph Glasgow as a child of James Glasgow and Mary McNeil. The 20 October 1820 birth follows their 20 November 1817 Adams County marriage and fits the documented local family.

Selected father-profile identity and paternal relationship; maternal identity is separate.

Next useful test: Trace Faris’s child entry to its original marriage/probate evidence.

Source basis already held: [https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Glasgow-2181 SOURCE: Faris, David, The Glasgow Family of Adams County, Ohio (Baltimore, MD, Gateway Press, Inc., 1990), p. 80]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.
